note: The SGI header fields are read from the candidate file; the chosen y-size and z-size make the RLE row table require more entries than the file supplies.
The input-controlled dimensions are multiplied to determine how many RLE start and length entries will be allocated and later checked.
Storage for all expected RLE start offsets is allocated for the input-controlled row count.
The loop stops when the truncated input reaches end-of-stream, so the safety obligation that every index below _numrows has been initialized is not enforced.
The sanity check iterates over all _numrows entries and reads _starttab[o], including entries left uninitialized by the truncated RLE offset table.
